problem_solved: Standard friction stir welding machinery handles variations in workpiece thickness poorly, requiring manual tool modifications that delay continuous production lines.
description: A specialized multi-mode friction stir welding (FSW) tool assembly built with a detachable main shaft, an adjustable shoulder body, an integrated pulley system, and a removable mode selector collar to shift dynamically between tool variants.
applications: Aerospace structural aluminum welding, automotive lightweight panel assembly, maritime shipyard manufacturing lines, and specialized tool fabrication shops.
